why_this_exists.statement: The completed scale-100 calibration validated physical layers 35, 38 and 40 on untouched confirmation and failed at 32 and 26. Layer 32 failed closely enough to motivate a larger calibration. The completed multimodal experiment then established controlled three-modality causal transfer at 35/38/40, and a native-output convergence audit found those layers already converged onto the clean answer. The next required scientific step is a validated EARLIER readout.
why_this_exists.descriptive_layer_policy: L20 and shallower are reported continuously at every scale and are DESCRIPTIVE unless they independently pass the same frozen gate on the fresh confirmation set.
why_this_exists.already_published_policy: The existing L35/L38/L40 published lenses remain unchanged. This extension neither overwrites, replaces nor republishes them; publish_early_layer refuses a destination outside its own run directory and refuses any layer outside the publication targets.

evidentiary_boundary.old_confirmation_set_reasoning: The scale-100 confirmation set has been opened and its result has been read. That result is what motivated this extension. A set whose verdict already influenced the decision to run a larger scale cannot be that scale's untouched endpoint.
evidentiary_boundary.old_confirmation_set_handling: Excluded from every new split by exact normalized checksum and by SimHash near-duplicate distance. Never reused, never relabelled, never reset.
evidentiary_boundary.old_development_set_handling: Excluded from every new split for the same reason.
evidentiary_boundary.reused_parent_state: the scale-100 fitting accumulator only: {jacobian_sum, n_done}
evidentiary_boundary.why_the_accumulator_is_reusable: J_l = E[dh_final/dh_l] is a population mean estimated by a running average over a deterministically ordered prompt list. jlens.fitting.fit reads no validation or confirmation result while accumulating it, so no held-out number could have influenced it. Continuing it is a longer fit, not a fit informed by its own evaluation.
evidentiary_boundary.parent_immutability_proof: every resolved parent file is checksummed before and after the extension and compared byte for byte

parent_run.baseline_scale_policy: Scale 100 is reported as a descriptive baseline and is scored on the FRESH development set so the plateau rule has three points. It cannot be newly confirmed: the set that would confirm it has been spent.
parent_run.missing_artifact_policy: STOP_AND_NAME_WHAT_MUST_BE_RECOVERED. No scientific metadata is inferred, defaulted, or reconstructed from a guess.

parent_fit_prompt_manifest.what_it_is: a checksum over the identities (record_id, stream_index, normalized text sha256, SimHash) of the first 100 fit records in the parent's nested order
parent_fit_prompt_manifest.why_it_is_sufficient: the parent recorded n_dropped_too_short = 0, so the fitted prefix IS the split prefix; the checksum therefore authenticates the exact prompts the parent fitted on
parent_fit_prompt_manifest.if_n_dropped_too_short_is_nonzero: REFUSE — the fitted prompt identity is not recoverable from stored artifacts

sites.residual_convention: pre-final-norm residual after attention, MLP, per-layer-embedding re-injection and layer_scalar; the exact input to block l+1

positions.target_rule: all current-and-future valid positions t' >= t, summed; then mean over source positions t

corpus.prompt_format: raw text, truncated to max_seq_len tokens, BOS prepended by Gemma4LensModel.encode

rule: 1. Reproduce the parent's collection exactly: same pinned corpus, same min_chars, same split seed and bucket layout, same quota stop rule.
2. Positions 0..99 are the parent's own fit partition in the parent's own nested order.
3. Any further positions come from records the parent's collection never reached, in ascending stream index — an ordering that cannot be perturbed by streaming further.
4. Recompute the checksum over the first 100 records and require exact agreement with the parent's fit-prompt manifest.
5. Only then seed the extension checkpoint from the parent accumulator and let upstream fit() skip those 100.
6. Consume the next 900 deterministic fit records; snapshot at 250 and at 1000.
continuation.why_not_the_nested_hash_order_over_the_l: re-running the parent's nested-hash ordering over a LONGER record set can insert a late-streamed record ahead of an early one, which would silently break the prefix nesting the continuation depends on. The pinned-prefix ordering is stable under stream extension; the pure hash ordering is not.
continuation.prefix_mismatch_policy: REFUSE. Appending 150 or 900 prompts to an accumulator built from a different 100 and calling the result a 250- or 1,000-prompt lens is exactly the failure this check exists for.
continuation.equivalence_claim: continuation to N is BIT-IDENTICAL to a fresh nested fit over the same ordering at N, because the additions happen in the same sequence
continuation.equivalence_demonstrated_in: MOCK mode and the CPU test suite, by refitting from scratch and comparing tensor by tensor
continuation.checkpoint_seeding: byte copy of the parent accumulator into the extension run directory, checksum-verified against the parent's; the parent file is opened read-only
continuation.resume: compatible resume continues; a checkpoint with different source_layers, target_layer or skip_first, or one behind the parent's n_done, is REFUSED

scale.nesting_note: the accumulator at prompt 250 IS the 250-prompt lens; the 1,000-prompt lens is that same accumulator continued. The two snapshots cost exactly as much as reaching 1,000 alone.

fresh_splits.pool: records the parent's collection never reached (stream index beyond the parent's stop point)
exclusions: every new fit record through scale 1000

exclusion_methods.exact: sha256 of normalized text (NFKC, lowercased, whitespace-collapsed, stripped)
exclusion_methods.near: 64-bit SimHash over word 3-grams, banded into 4 x 16-bit bands, Hamming distance <= 3

fresh_splits.cross_split_leakage_audit: run independently on the constructed sets, against each other and against every excluded set; a hit RAISES
fresh_splits.shrink_policy: REFUSE. Held-out sizes are never reduced because corpus coverage was inconvenient.

target_diversity.target_rule: the frozen model's own final-layer argmax at the last prompt position; no lens and no candidate layer is consulted

rule: 1. Determine the eligible earlier-layer set at scale 250 and scale 1000 on the DEVELOPMENT set, using the unchanged gate.
2. Select the smallest candidate scale whose eligible earlier-layer set equals the scale-1000 set, provided the predeclared plateau rule reports that improvement has stopped.
4. If neither L32 nor L26 passes development at any candidate scale, still select scale 1000 for one honest confirmation and report the result whatever it says.
5. Record that confirmation was not consulted.
scale_selection.post_hoc_scale_choice: forbidden — the confirmation vault opens only against a written selection payload that asserts confirmation_not_consulted

confirmation.vault: jlens.calibration.publication.ConfirmationVault, fresh instance holding the new 256-record confirmation set

never_overwrite: the parent run rgcalib_real_7e3736b4de8f in its entirety
publication.no_go_statement: the current estimator did not yield a validated earlier readout at the authorized endpoint

budget.anchor_source: the operator's observed scale-100 fit on one NVIDIA L4
budget.extrapolation: linear in prompts; one forward plus 320 backward passes per prompt at dim_batch=8
budget.uncertainty_note: one observation, one runtime, one prompt-length distribution. The high end is the planning number.
